Input 1 and 2 are locked style reference props.png and scene.png; input 3 is the bloomery design to preserve. Show only its very low circular clay-and-stone base ring with the front arch just beginning: no upper shaft, no fire, no smoke. Retain exactly the bloomery footprint width, warm terracotta and grey stone materials, south/front opening, and same front three-quarter about20-degree-down camera. This is a placed component on genuine transparent background, no ground patch or cast shadow puddle. Whole subject has generous transparent margins. Intended opaque size about40px wide by18px high at game scale, illustrating the initial lower courses of the56px-high source. Ink-and-tone field-guide art: fine sepia-charcoal broken contours, main-to-secondary line ratio2:1; clay3 short crack groups, stone3 selective facet groups, one group of3 parallel / hatch strokes. Restrained broad earth wash plus distinct darker right/lower shadow, light upper-left. Do not use photoreal texture, dense crosshatching, smooth3D bevels, roof, text, border or scenery. Generate only this foundation state, one object.
